Also known as the Carlin Gems Quest. {npc:Padreia}, of the Carlin druid guild, had a vision: a plague is going to come out of the city sewers, spread by slimes. She gives you a vial of poison to pour into the water the slimes come from. If you do, you receive four small gems.
The sewers of Carlin may be the source of a plague!
given by Padreia at the start
The sewers have several {creature:Slime|Slimes} and {creature:Bug|Bugs}: bring some health potions.
The quest is part of the {wiki:Tibia Tales}.

To get to **Carlin**, take a boat (for example in Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Captain Greyhound}'s harbour. Go to the druids' guild in **Carlin** and talk to {npc:Padreia}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. She gives you a {item:Special Flask (Padreia)|special flask} with poison and your Quest Log is updated.
The special flask you get from Padreia
Go to the sewer grate, east of the guild, and go down.
Walk **south**, ready to fight a few {creature:Slime|Slimes}. Then go down one more floor, where there are more Slimes.
Use the {item:Special Flask (Padreia)|poison flask} on the water. Your Quest Log is updated.
Pouring the poison into the water
Go back the same way: go up to the first floor of the sewers, walk **north** to the entrance and go up through the grate to the streets of Carlin, just east of the druids' guild.
Go back to {npc:Padreia} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. She thanks you for saving Carlin and gives you the reward.
